justification: The only notable correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry small schematic human/creature figures scattered in loose horizontal tiers, and both include a horizontal line topped by a row of repeated short vertical strokes (a hatched band in A, crew-strokes above a curved hull in B), which is a coincidental resemblance rather than a shared motif. Otherwise the depicted content is entirely different: A shows profile animals — birds with hooked beaks, quadrupeds, a snake — plus a small anthropomorph, rendered in modelled relief with recognisable species detail, while B shows crescent-hulled boats with upturned prows, stick-figure humans and a handled/gridded object, drawn as flat, extremely reduced silhouettes with no animals of the kinds seen in A.
